entries.message: Continuous integration compiles the Mac and iOS test targets, so a test that no longer builds fails the change.
The architecture guard keeps WebKit imports to the WebKit adapters and the Chromium host condition to the engine, and now also checks the agents and the Chromium shell.
The validation scripts pick a supported Python, the dead-code audit runs on current Periphery and scans the Chromium product, and the identity check keeps only the identities persistence relies on.
The core's analyzers now reject unused private members, and the twelve unused test members they found are gone.
Continuous integration compiles each app and its tests in one Release build, with the test fixtures compiled into that build only.
